# Annex A — Variable naming conventions {#ch10-annex-a-variable-naming-conventions}

Harmonized names use snake_case. Every EGRA/EGMA subtask shares a subtask stem; individual fields add an item number or metric suffix.

```{=html}
<div class="ahead-table-wrap">
<table class="ahead-data-table">
  <tr>
    <th>Task</th>
    <th>Core stem</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Number identification</td>
    <td><code>num_id</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Number discrimination</td>
    <td><code>quant_comp</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Addition level I</td>
    <td><code>addlvl1</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Addition level II</td>
    <td><code>addlvl2</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Subtraction level I</td>
    <td><code>sublvl1</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Subtraction level II</td>
    <td><code>sublvl2</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Word problems</td>
    <td><code>word_prob</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Missing number</td>
    <td><code>miss_num</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Multiplication</td>
    <td><code>mult</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Fractions</td>
    <td><code>frac</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Shape identification</td>
    <td><code>shape_id</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Written exercise</td>
    <td><code>we_add</code>, <code>we_sub</code>, <code>we_mult</code>, <code>we_div</code></td>
  </tr>
</table>
</div>
```

*Table 13: Standard EGRA subtask prefixes*

```{=html}
<div class="ahead-table-wrap">
<table class="ahead-data-table">
  <tr>
    <th>Pattern</th>
    <th>Typical meaning</th>
    <th>Harmonized treatment</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>l2_</code>, <code>mt</code>, <code>mt1</code>&ndash;<code>mt3</code></td>
    <td>Second language / mother tongue</td>
    <td>Separate <code>l2_*</code> stem</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>unt</code>, <code>k_unt</code></td>
    <td>Untimed administration</td>
    <td>Separate stem (e.g. <code>unt_oral_read</code>)</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>lb</code>, <code>ext_lb</code>, <code>ilb</code></td>
    <td>Look-back comprehension</td>
    <td>Separate stem or <code>read_compB</code> variant</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>B, A on stem</td>
    <td>Alternate passage or section</td>
    <td>Separate stem (<code>oral_readB</code>, <code>vocabB</code>)</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>eq</code>, <code>k_eq</code>, <code>r_eq</code></td>
    <td>Baseline-adjusted equivalent score</td>
    <td>Excluded</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>i</code>, <code>i1</code>&ndash;<code>i3</code></td>
    <td>Imputed values</td>
    <td>Excluded</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>t</code>, <code>ht</code>, <code>sso</code></td>
    <td>Teacher / head teacher / staff</td>
    <td>Excluded (non-pupil)</td>
  </tr>
</table>
</div>
```
